title.narrative: Røde Kors Danmark/ICRC indsats i Yemen 2023-2024

description.narrative:
This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of the 2022 ICRC Yemen Appeal that points to humanitarian needs amounting to 134 million CHF.
The activities covered by the appeal include promoting compliance with IHL and humanitarian access and protecting civilians. Activities will contribute to strengthened access to health services through support for 42 health centres and 31 hospitals; food assistance for 221,500 persons; support for improved food production targeting 630,000 people; and improved access to water and sanitation for 3,3 million people. Health services include access to mental health and psychosocial support. Activities also include helping people contact their relatives and addressing the issues of missing people, as well as ensuring proper treatment of and conditions for detainees.
Annual report can be found through this link: https://www.icrc.org/en/annual-report
This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of the 2023 ICRC Yemen Appeal that points to humanitarian needs amounting to 136 million CHF.
